result.instructions: Tools for SingleOps, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which operations (divisions) does our SingleOps account have?"; "Is there already a client with the email jane@example.com?"; "Create a lead for a tree trimming quote at 101 Test Ave, Atlanta, for the Main operation.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SingleOps data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run singleops_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run singleops_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run singleops_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. singleops_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: singleops_list_operations
tools.title: List operations (divisions)
tools.description: List the operations (divisions) of the SingleOps account. A lead needs an operation `id` from this list. Read-only.

tools.name: singleops_list_custom_inputs
tools.title: List custom inputs
tools.description: List the custom input fields of the account (for example a 'Lead Source' field). Use the `id` as `custom_input_id` when you create a lead. Read-only.

tools.name: singleops_search_clients
tools.title: Search clients by email or phone
tools.description: Search existing clients by email or phone (prefix match, up to 50 results per page). Search first, then pass the client `id` to singleops_create_lead to avoid a duplicate client. Read-only.

search_term.description: Email address or phone number (prefix match).

annotations.title: Search clients by email or phone

tools.name: singleops_create_lead
tools.title: Create a lead
tools.description: WRITE: create a new lead in SingleOps (stage Lead). Not idempotent: each call creates a new lead, so do not repeat it. Needs `operation_id` (singleops_list_operations) and either `client_id` (singleops_search_clients) or client details in `portal_lead`. A person must confirm the lead in SingleOps before it counts as valid. Optionally creates a task with it.

client_id.description: Existing client id. Leave out for a new client.

crew_notes.description: Notes shown on the work order.

sales_rep_ids.description: User ids that own the lead.

portal_lead.description: Client contact and site address details.

task.description: Create a task together with the lead.
